interpretation_and_gates.memory_gate: Allocated peak is lower in the owner integrated cases, while peak reserved is higher by the same allocator-cache-sized delta across variants; total memory acceptance remains open until the separate post-setup lifecycle accounting resolves it.
interpretation_and_gates.numerical_gate: These timing runs do not compare output/gradient values against baseline. Full-shape numerical replay remains assigned to the coordinator.
interpretation_and_gates.observed: All six integrated cases and both diagnostic cases executed on the actual eight-rank GFSDP/NCCL paths at the crop shape. Baseline and owner used identical per-rank input IDs and route censuses. Owner returned a completed dense FP32 gradient in every run; its scratch view aliased the existing head buffer.
interpretation_and_gates.production_gate: No native training throughput, convergence, or long-run stability claim is made.
interpretation_and_gates.single_pair_limit: One serial baseline-then-owner pair with three samples per case; no A/A or alternating repeat. Median ratios are descriptive only, not general speedup claims.
interpretation_and_gates.trace_gate: Raw traces are captured; device/communication attribution by MCP Perfetto remains pending coordinator analysis.

interpretation.counts: Count all-gather plus the explicit host count-matrix read and CPU split/validity work.

interpretation.owner_reduction: Per-source widening/FP32 reduction and persistent dense owner-gradient accumulation.
interpretation.partition_ids: Input validation, ID sorting/deduplication, and inverse mapping.
interpretation.source_coalescing#1: Native dense BF16 embedding backward and its native scratch.
interpretation.source_coalescing#2: Select coalesced source rows into borrowed scratch.

retained_owner_routing_metadata.lifetime: retained until backward; not aliased into borrowed scratch

timer_semantics.integrated: CUDA event span and synchronized wall for complete F+B; the communication stream joins completion events before endpoint; host call includes internal count reads and waits; endpoint synchronization is separate.
timer_semantics.phases: F and B separately with a synchronization boundary between them; diagnostic only and must not be summed to claim integrated latency.
timer_semantics.stages: StageObserver CUDA-event spans on the actual stage stream plus host context-call spans, without per-stage barriers. They include submission gaps/waits and are not kernel-only durations.
timer_semantics.unavailable_until_trace_analysis: Device compute, copy/collective attribution, and internal host wait dependency decomposition; owner-stage Chrome traces are retained for MCP analysis.
